# hosts.toml

<!-- generated by `letibot --config-reference --markdown hosts.toml`; do not edit -->

Location: $LETIBOT_HOSTS, else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/letibot/hosts.toml, else ~/.config/letibot/hosts.toml

machines letibot may place sessions, children and gates on over ssh (docs/remote-hosts.md)

## `[host.<name>]`

NAME is what --host and `host:NAME` take. Unknown keys and a key stated twice fail the whole file. Values are one line.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hostname` | string | NAME | what ssh connects to |
| `user` | string | ssh's own | login user |
| `key` | path | ~/.config/letibot/keys/NAME | identity file; absolute, outside ~/.ssh |
| `path` | list of dirs | [] | put in front of the remote PATH |
| `root` | path | ~/letibot-remote | where remote worktrees live |
| `mise` | false \| "program" | found once and cached | mise wrapper: false = off, a string names it |
| `reserve` | int | 0 | cores kept back for the owner; reported only |
| `flags` | list of words | [] | free-form host words (heavy, tmpfs) |
| `never_touch` | list of names | [] | processes, compose projects and containers letibot never stops there |

## `[local]`

The machine the daemon runs on.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `never_touch` | list of names | [] | processes, compose projects and containers letibot never stops here |
